method: conversion pipeline over a pre-existing fp32 A2E model (no training performed in the Omote repo)
architecture: Wav2Vec2-base dual-head: 52 ARKit blendshapes (A2E) + CTC ASR; inputs audio float32 [1, 16000] @ 16 kHz + identity one-hot float32 [1, 12]; implementation tag wav2arkit_v1

base_checkpoint.note: HONEST-UNKNOWN per the Omote asset-custody tenet: the exact pretrained Wav2Vec2 checkpoint and the party that performed the A2E fine-tune are not establishable from the Omote repository's docs, registry, or training scripts - no training script for this model exists there. Repo docs identify the third-party myned-ai/wav2arkit_cpu as an older fp32 baseline of the same Wav2ARKit A2E family. Recorded as unknown rather than invented.

fp32_parent: fp32 single-file model formerly hosted at omote-ai/lam-a2e (fp32/ prefix), removed after the fp16 exports superseded it

derived_artifacts.model_fp16.onnx + .data: surgical Tier-2 mixed-precision fp16 (scripts/model-exports/lam-desktop/convert_fp16_surgical.py in the Omote repo) - decomposed-LayerNorm subgraphs kept fp32; cosine similarity 0.999999 vs fp32 reference on WebGPU
derived_artifacts.lam_ios.onnx + .data: iOS/Safari surgery (scripts/model-exports/lam-ios/convert_v2.py) - opset 14 to 18, 32 LayerNorms fused (1339 to 608 nodes), CTC head removed, fp16

eval.note: No standing model-quality eval script - legacy pre-governance artifact; conversion fidelity was gated at export time by the export kits.
